name: pt_unbundling_ownership_2026_08_29
claim: Perpetua-Tools must be unbundled by capability authority rather than copied wholesale into perpetua-core. Existing destination repos are perpetua-core for universal dependency-minimal execution mechanics, orama-system for GraphSpec/lint/evaluation/effect policy, oramasys/oramasys for application/service composition, and oramasys/agate for hardware capability/affinity contracts. PT memory, observability, coordination/mesh, endpoint/security, agent/provider adapters, research tooling, and operational harnesses should first become explicit satellite module/package boundaries; new standalone repository names are provisional until dependency graph and release cadence justify them. Migration is strangler-style: inventory, freeze behavior with contract tests, define destination interface, dual-run/differential-test where useful, migrate consumers, declare authority/sunset, then delete legacy writable copies. Never move provider/network/storage/policy concerns into the core scheduler merely for convenience. Preserve append-only memory, fail-closed security, one writable source of truth, and mutator != evaluator throughout migration.

decisions.notes: Direct operator instruction to plan migration of all existing PT features into perpetua-core and other repos as PT is unbundled into satellite modules.
